_note: Which Python environment each model needs.
More than one is required, and this is an upstream constraint rather than a
preference: some model families only load under transformers 4.x, others only
under 5.x, and the two requirements are mutually exclusive.
Environment count is kept minimal rather than one per model. Several models
state no required version at all, so building them a dedicated 'official'
environment would mean inventing one and calling it official. Changing the
transformers version also changes model output, so a per-model version would
make the software stack an uncontrolled variable across the comparison.
Switching is automatic: the orchestrator dispatches each model to the
interpreter it needs. No manual activation.
